parent_objective: design a no-training residual component sensitivity probe after vector gate component collapse

public_gates: M791 designs an audit-only residual component sensitivity probe
M791 uses frozen M568 actor and frozen M761 residual head
M791 defines component masks for steer throttle brake and combinations
M791 defines active-source and intervention-gap metrics
M791 blocks training PPO and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor residual or calibrator parameters
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not weaken strict normal retention or gap metrics
do not claim broad generalization or true four-wheel physical fidelity

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: moves from failed vector-gate training to no-training component attribution for the M761 residual head
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no implementation training PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if design trains any parameters
stop if design changes actor input contract
stop if design omits active-source alpha 0.2 analysis
fallback_plan: if component masks are insufficient, design trajectory-time component ablation
if active-source attribution is ambiguous, design focused active-source sweep
if no component explains gap or collision, stop residual calibration and return to corpus or architecture evidence
if one component dominates, design component-attributed vector objective
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M790 selects component sensitivity after vector-gate collapse

hypothesis: A no-training residual component sensitivity design can identify which M761 residual action dimensions are responsible for intervention lift and active-source normal collision risk.
success_criteria: M791 documents component masks and alpha ladder
M791 documents active-source and aggregate metrics
M791 documents how to compare each component mask against M780 M786 and M789
M791 keeps training PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: design weakens strict normal retention or gap thresholds
decision_rule: M791 may only design a no-training residual component sensitivity probe. It must not implement, train, run PPO, mutate actor or residual parameters, or promote a checkpoint.
